parameters.name: AllKeyPrefix
parameters.description: Specifies whether to match all file prefixes.

parameters.name: DecompressMaxFileCount
parameters.description: The maximum number of files to decompress. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 1000. When the maximum number of decompressed files is exceeded, the decompression operation ends immediately. The detection of files that have already been decompressed is not affected.

parameters.name: DecompressMaxLayer
parameters.description: The maximum number of decompression layers when multiple levels of nested compressed files exist. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 5. When the maximum number of decompression layers is exceeded, the decompression operation ends immediately. The detection of files that have already been decompressed is not affected.

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the policy. Valid values:
- **1**: Enabled.
- **0**: Disabled.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The scan stop time in the HH:mm:ss format.

parameters.name: LastModifiedStartTime
parameters.description: Specifies that only files whose last modification time is after the specified timestamp are scanned. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: RealTimeIncr
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable real-time incremental detection. When this parameter is set to true, the ScanDayList, StartTime, and EndTime parameters do not take effect.

parameters.name: ScanDayList
parameters.description: The scan days. The number indicates the day of the week.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The business source. Valid values:
- **OSS**: OSS
- **NAS**: NAS

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The scan start time in the HH:mm:ss format.
